description: This file implements the ProxyList class, which manages a list of proxy servers, including setting proxies, deprioritizing bad proxies, serialization, and retry logic. It is part of the net namespace and interacts with proxy server utilities and logging.

classes.name: ProxyList
classes.description: A class that manages a list of proxy servers, providing methods to set, modify, serialize, and handle proxy server retries.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the proxy list from a semicolon-separated string of proxy URIs.

methods.name: SetSingleProxyServer
methods.description: Sets the proxy list to contain a single specified proxy server.

methods.name: AddProxyServer
methods.description: Adds a valid proxy server to the list.

methods.name: DeprioritizeBadProxies
methods.description: Reorders proxies, moving known bad proxies to the end of the list based on retry info.

methods.name: RemoveProxiesWithoutScheme
methods.description: Removes proxies that do not match the specified scheme bit field.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the proxy list is empty.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of proxies in the list.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if two ProxyList instances contain the same proxies.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the first proxy in the list.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Returns all proxies in the list.

methods.name: SetFromPacString
methods.description: Parses a PAC string to populate the proxy list, defaults to DIRECT if parsing fails.

methods.name: ToPacString
methods.description: Serializes the proxy list into a PAC string.

methods.name: ToValue
methods.description: Converts the proxy list to a base::Value representation.

methods.name: Fallback
methods.description: Handles fallback logic when a proxy fails, removing it from the list and updating retry info.

methods.name: AddProxyToRetryList
methods.description: Marks a proxy as bad and adds it to the retry info map.

methods.name: UpdateRetryInfoOnFallback
methods.description: Updates retry info for proxies after a fallback event, including additional proxies to bypass.
